critical_code_review_comments: server.py continues to grow (~975 lines) — split into modules (auth, destinations, partners, itineraries, planner, storage) is overdue.

trip_planner_stream truncates partner description to 150 chars but does not cap number of partners per destination — a destination with many approved partners could bloat the system prompt token count. Add e.g. `partners_by_dest[dest_id][:5]`.

Sanitization `''.join(ch for ch in raw_ctx if ch.isprintable())[:200]` is applied AFTER Pydantic max_length=200 — combined behavior is correct but the double-cap is redundant; a single client- and server-side hard cap would be cleaner.
Streaming endpoint has no per-IP rate limiting; each call spends real LLM tokens. Consider a lightweight throttle (e.g., 1 req / 10s per IP or per session).

Frontend `renderMarkdown` in Planner.jsx does not treat blockquote lines starting with `>` — the Mitra Lokal sub-section is rendered as a plain paragraph, so the visual distinction (`> **Mitra Lokal:**`) is lost. Add a simple `>` handler to render as a styled blockquote for better UX.
